checks.criterion: The Thermal Atlas dashboard still loads with Ladakh branding and the simulation controls
checks.name: thermal-dashboard-loads
checks.evidence: THERMAL ATLAS, Ladakh subtitle, simulation controls, climate location control, and empty results state were visible.

checks.criterion: Live weather readings are visible or degrade gracefully
checks.name: weather-live-readings-visible
checks.evidence: Weather panel showed a valid live/offline/syncing status; live state exposed current temperature/source, and refresh control was visible.

checks.criterion: A user can import measured weather CSV data
checks.name: weather-csv-imports
checks.evidence: Uploaded a CSV using datetime, temp, and solar_irradiance aliases; weather source changed to Uploaded measured CSV and readings remained visible.

checks.criterion: Imported weather can be applied to the thermal model
checks.name: weather-import-applies-to-model
checks.evidence: Imported measured readings changed the ambient model range, Use readings in model applied them, and analysis produced the normal metric card.

checks.criterion: A user can download a historical climate sample CSV
checks.name: weather-sample-csv-downloads
checks.evidence: Historical sample action completed a browser download with a weather-sample.csv filename.

checks.criterion: ANSYS handoff exports produce real files
checks.name: ansys-handoff-exports-download
checks.evidence: After analysis, CSV export downloaded a thermal-series.csv file and JSON export downloaded an ansys-parameters.json file.

checks.criterion: The existing analysis and saved-run flow remains functional
checks.name: thermal-analysis-completes
checks.evidence: Run analysis revealed metrics, temperature chart, heat-flow card, scenario comparison, and recommendation.

checks.criterion: The existing analysis and saved-run flow remains functional
checks.name: thermal-saved-run-revisited
checks.evidence: Saved a unique tscheck run, found it in recent runs, revisited it, and restored metrics/chart and saved name.

checks.criterion: Weather API validation and fallback routes work through the public contract
checks.name: test_tscheck_weather_contract.py
checks.evidence: HTTP GET /api/weather/live and /api/weather/sample returned 200 structured data; POST /api/weather/import returned 200 for aliases and 422 for non-CSV/malformed input.

checks.criterion: Running analysis populates the thermal API response and rejects invalid payloads
checks.name: test_tscheck_thermal_analysis.py
checks.evidence: HTTP POST /api/analyze returned 200 with chart points, heat flows, scenarios, and recommendation; invalid dimensions returned 422.

checks.criterion: A completed analysis can be persisted and listed by the API
checks.name: test_tscheck_saved_analysis.py
checks.evidence: HTTP POST /api/analyses and GET /api/analyses returned 200 and the unique tscheck fixture was listed; empty name returned 422.

checks.criterion: Backend public analysis contract remains healthy
checks.name: test_tscheck_api_contract.py
checks.evidence: Contract suite passed analyze/save/list requests and rejected duration_hours=2 with 422.
